title: Words carved on the waystones
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.text: Touch the stone if you are lost; it remembers the road home.
Touch my ring. The light will pull you home from any dark place.
Stone hums cold. Touch it to return home.
Stone hums when touched; light rings for Eliet.
The stone hums warm; touch the ring to return home if you bleed out in the dark.
Touch me to rest; I hold the name for Smith Hale.
The stone here hums softly; keep your nanites quiet and do not touch the runes until you are ready.
Stand steady on the stone where light hums below your hand.
The stone hums when you touch it. Nine died down there. One came back with a map.
Touch me and step back to Eliet's cold hearth.
The stone hums when you stand near the deep dark.
Welcome home, child. The stone remembers the first nine who went down.
